rules.statement: Non-compliance with the time limit stipulated by Section 2(2)(c) of the Termination of Employment of Workmen (Special Provisions) Act No. 45 of 1971 does not render the Commissioner's order void.
rules.supporting_quote: "Further the Petitioner, having participated in the proceedings without any objection and having taken the chance of the final outcome of the proceedings, is precluded from raising any objection to the jurisdiction of the Commissioner of Labour to make a valid Order after the zero hour. The jurisdictional defect, if any, has been cured by the Petitioner's consent and acquiescence."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 2(2)(c) of the Termination of Employment of Workmen (Special Provisions) Act No. 45 of 1971
